comments.body_html: currently only muzzle devices and grips affect recoil due to bullpups not being able to equip a stock, pistol grip, buffer tube etc. before release i felt that giving bullpups a “magical” 50% recoil reduction wasnt the right choice but maybe ill have to do it to compensate.
